'''Michael Peter Muscala''' (born July 1, 1991) is an American former [[college basketball]] player for the [[Bucknell Bison men's basketball|Bucknell Bison men's basketball team]] for four seasons. He was the 2011 [[Patriot League Men's Basketball Player of the Year]] after leading the Bison to an [[2011 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|NCAA Tournament]] appearance. In addition, he was named to the First Team All-Patriot League and AP All-American Honorable Mention in 2010-2011.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.patriotleague.org/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/022811aab.html|title=All-Patriot League, Major Awards Announced for Men's Basketball|work=[[Patriot League]]|date=February 28, 2011|accessdate=September 14, 2011}}</ref> He was a 2012–13 [[Academic All-America]] selection.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.cosida.com/news.aspx?id=3973|title=Delaware's Elena Delle Donne, Ohio State's Aaron Craft top Capital One Academic All-America® Division I Basketball Teams|accessdate=2013-02-21|date=2013-02-21|publisher=[[College Sports Information Directors of America]]}}</ref> He was also a 2012–13 [[List of Senior CLASS Award men's basketball winners|Senior CLASS Award]] finalist.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.iuhoosiers.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/020613aad.html|title=Hulls Named Finalist for Senior CLASS Award|accessdate=2013-02-13|date=2013-02-06|publisher=[[CBS Interactive]]|work=IUHoosiers.com}}</ref> Muscala also earned more hardware in 2013 as he won the 2013 Patriot League Player of the Year, Defensive Player of the Year, and First-Team All Conference honors.<ref>2012-13 men's basketball all-patriot league team and major awards announced. (2013, 030413). Retrieved from http://www.patriotleague.org/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/030413aad.html</ref> During his 2012–13 campaign, Muscala also become Bucknell's all-time leading scorer surpassing Al Leslie's 32 year record.<ref>Top seeds advance in patriot league men's basketball tournament. (2013, 030613). Retrieved from http://www.patriotleague.org/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/030613aac.html </ref>
